families.relay: operate: MODULE_EVENT_NEW -> MODULE_WAIT_MODULE, then MODULE_EVENT_MODDONE finishes (nothing listed: Unbound's reply is the answer)
families.zone_exact: evaluate_domain: dataDB exact lookup, fed by build/tld_wildcard_classify (plain feed lines are exact without Wildcard Blocking)
families.zone_wildcard: evaluate_domain: find_zone_match suffix walk over zoneDB (ABP ||host^ lines)
families.tld_block: build: tld_wildcard_blacklist roots become DNSBL_TLD zoneDB entries
families.tld_allow: evaluate_domain: _tld_allow_blocks (names outside the allowed TLD roots are blocked)
families.psl: tld_wildcard_classify: public-suffix-aware zone/exact classification of plain feed lines
families.idn: evaluate_domain: idn_mode_decision and idn_confusable_action (All-IDN and Confusable modes)
families.abp: parse_abp and reconcile: ABP rule lines folded into dataDB, zoneDB and whiteDB
families.allow: evaluate_domain fast path: whitelist_check_domain over the user whitelist (important_rules False)
families.hsts: evaluate_domain: hsts_check_domain turns a VIP block into a null block
families.response: evaluate_domain log_type shapes the operate block answer: VIP, null, NXDOMAIN, NODATA
families.qtype: operate: the q_type in rr_types gate; a blocked non-address type answers NODATA
families.in_addr_arpa: operate: names under in-addr.arpa are left out of the DNSBL validation list
families.group_policy: _load_gp_bypass_list and _gp_bypassed: a bypassed client is never DNSBL-checked
families.cname: operate: python_cname CNAME-chain validation in the MODDONE pass
families.noaaaa: evaluate_noaaaa and find_noaaaa_wildcard_parent: AAAA answered NODATA for listed names
families.safesearch: safesearch_entry and operate: A/AAAA rewrite, nxdomain row and www. fallback
families.control: operate: the python_control TXT branch and pfb_apply_control_command
families.frontend: Frontend.resolve in dns_proxy/pfb_dns_proxy.py, before pfb_unbound.py runs: the header guards, _module_decides, Unbound's silence, and _rendered's UDP and stream size limits
